visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a black baseball cap with a fox patch and a grey button-up dress stands in a bookstore aisle. She gestures towards shelves of colorful books under a 'Fantasy' sign with her right hand. (2) She touches her cap and continues talking to the camera, gesturing with both hands towards the book collection, appearing overwhelmed by choices. (3) She holds up a book titled 'Spark of the Everflame', rotating it to show the intricate green and gold patterns printed on the page edges. (4) She holds a purple book titled 'The Hurricane Wars' and flips it to showcase the gold moon-phase patterns on its purple-sprayed edges. (5) A fast-paced montage shows close-ups of various books like 'Harry Potter' and 'My Funny Demon Valentine', highlighting different sprayed edge designs including stars, flowers, and geometric patterns. (6) She holds a book with floral-patterned edges close to the camera, smiling while displaying the detailed artwork on the side of the pages.
